title: sativa-epang: SATIVA with EPA-ng as the placement engine
description:
A fork of SATIVA (Kozlov et al. 2016) that replaces the RAxML placement engine with EPA-ng (Barbera et al. 2019) in both the leave-one-out and the final confirmation pass, while leaving SATIVA's classification and decision logic unchanged: EPA-ng edges are mapped back onto SATIVA's own branch numbering by leaf bipartition.

Measured against unmodified SATIVA v0.9.3 on ITS alignments, the leave-one-out drops from 257 s to 15.4 s at 1600 sequences and from 1536 s to 87 s at 5402, with 0.98 recall and 0.90 precision at 800 sequences.

The leave-one-out can also be driven one step at a time, so a workflow manager can build the reference, prepare the folds, place them across a cluster and score the result as separate jobs, with byte-identical output either way. A reference tree inferred elsewhere can be supplied instead of having SATIVA infer it.

Distributed through Bioconda as sativa-epang. Please cite the original SATIVA paper alongside this record.
